results.title: Tether leads Belo's $14 million raise to expand stablecoin payments across Latin America
results.description: Belo, a Latin America-focused digital wallet that uses crypto rails for payments, has raised $14 million in a Series A round led by stablecoin issuer Tether. The round included Titan Fund, The Venture City, Mindset Ventures and G2.

results.title: stablecoin payments for fast, low-cost transfers
results.description: For freelancers already juggling multiple invoicing tools, adding stablecoin integration can be as straightforward as connecting a compatible wallet or using a payments platform that supports both fiat and digital currency rails. By scheduling batch payouts, you can slash per-transaction fees and keep your global collaborators paid on time without extra manual work.
